Sources stay enabled and disclosed; none is counted as fresh-alert until MONITOR_OK is verified from production (restore path: production fetch proxy, owner decision).

AML/CFT Part III) was promoted to fresh_alert on 2026-07-18 after two stable production runs and counts in the headline and in this row; its registry proof fields sync on the next intake. The 30-day revision-updates view is in remediation pending a production rebaseline. The public register is held as an evidence-library snapshot and the regulatory-notices/enforcement index is a candidate pending validation. This is selected-source monitoring, not complete VARA coverage.

DFSA depth continues via the dfsaen.thomsonreuters.com rulebook platform, which does work from production — the rulebook source passes the full readiness gate and the AML rulebook module was promoted to fresh_alert on 2026-07-18 after rebaseline plus stable-run gates (its registry readiness fields sync on the next intake). The DFSA public register is held as an evidence-library snapshot; the news hub (legislative amendment notices) and SEO letters listings are candidates pending validation under the same production-egress constraint.

This is selected DIFC monitoring, not complete DIFC legal database coverage.

ADGM/FSRA has 9 fresh-alert sources including guidance/policy and RA/circular/rulebook style sources. Three candidate rows remain held until selectors/extraction pass the same gates, and two listing pages (Office of Data Protection, media announcements hub) are held as evidence-library snapshots.
